reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 活动计划不够清楚时怎么问

materials.title: Ask Missing Plan Details 025
materials.text: Each short plan is missing one detail. Choose the question that asks for that detail.

questions.prompt: The note says, "Meet at the gate." Your school has two gates. What do you ask?
options: Which gate do we meet at?
questions.explanation: A两个门需明确哪门；B树龄、C门喜好不补集合地点。

questions.prompt: The note says, "Come after lunch." You need an exact time. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: B问具体到达时刻；A餐食、C勺主不解决时间模糊。

questions.prompt: The class needs cans for a craft. You do not know if they should be empty. What do you ask?
questions.explanation: C确认罐是否空；A云大、B鸟飞与材料状态无关。

questions.prompt: A meeting is outdoors, and rain is possible. You want to know the rain plan. What do you ask?
options: Will we meet inside if it rains?
questions.explanation: A问下雨时是否室内，补备用地点；B衣色、C星数不问雨案。

questions.prompt: The poster says, "Bring a game." You want to know what kind. What do you ask?
options: What kind of game should I bring?
Is the poster made of paper?
questions.explanation: B问游戏种类；A有园、C海报纸材不解决携带要求。

units.title: 在家说清楚需要的帮助

materials.title: Home Help Specific Needs 025
materials.text: Choose the useful sentence for each clearly stated need at home.

questions.prompt: The room is too dark for your book. You ask Dad for more light. What do you say?
options: Could you turn on the lamp?
questions.explanation: B开灯改善读书照明；A藏书、C闭眼不能增加光。

questions.prompt: Your chair is wet. You want a cloth to dry it. What do you say?
options: May I have a bigger window?
May I have a toy fish?
May I have a dry cloth?
questions.explanation: C索干布擦湿座；A窗、B鱼玩具不达清干目的。

questions.prompt: You cannot reach a book on a high shelf. You ask an adult. What do you say?
options: Could you get that book for me?
Could you put every book higher?
questions.explanation: A请求成人取高书；B浇架无关；C都放更高加剧困难。

questions.prompt: Both your hands hold a large box. You want Mum to open the door. What do you say?
options: Please take the door away forever.
Could you open the door for me?
Please give me another heavy box.
questions.explanation: B求开门解决双手占用；A拆门过度非需求；C再加箱不帮助。

questions.prompt: Your brother is asleep. You want a friend to lower their voice. What do you say?
options: Please speak quietly; he is asleep.
questions.explanation: C低声并说明熟睡条件；A喊、B持续拍均会打扰，与目的相反。

materials.title: Correct Small Misunderstandings 025
materials.text: Read each misunderstanding and choose the sentence that corrects the stated problem politely.

questions.prompt: You asked for plain paper, but a friend gives you lined paper. What do you say?
options: Thank you, but I need plain paper.
Thank you, I need more lines.
questions.explanation: A感谢后明确空白纸；B要更多线与原需相反；C食纸不纠偏。

questions.prompt: A friend thinks your cardboard model is rubbish and starts to bin it. What do you say?
options: Please keep that; it is my model.
questions.explanation: B说明模型身份阻误丢；A鼓励丢反目的；C桶形不能纠正物品用途误认。

questions.prompt: The helper gives you a ticket for tomorrow, but you need today. What do you say?
options: I need no ticket at all.
Sorry, I need a ticket for today.
questions.explanation: C明确今日票，礼貌纠时间；A混同日期；B不需票与实际目标相反。

questions.prompt: Your friend brings an indoor ball to a muddy field. You need the outdoor one. What do you say?
options: Let us use the outdoor ball here.
Let us fill the indoor ball with mud.
Let us stop using all balls forever.
questions.explanation: A场地需户外球，纠器材选择；B灌泥、C永久禁球非目标。

questions.prompt: A friend thinks you have finished eating and takes your plate. You are still eating. What do you say?
options: Please leave it; I have not finished yet.
The plate is not a tree.
questions.explanation: B澄清未吃完请留盘；A让拿走反目标；C无关类比不纠进度误解。

units.title: 花园日的十段完整语境

materials.title: Garden Day Ten Sentences 025
materials.text: Read each complete garden-day situation and choose the best word or reply.

questions.prompt: We are thirsty. ____ drink some clean water.
questions.explanation: B Let us后接drink表示一起喝；A单独Let缺宾语；C Lets无撇号也不构成本句祈使建议。

questions.prompt: The sun is hot. My little brother ____ a hat now.
questions.explanation: C is wearing构成现在进行；A原形不配单三且不表now进行；B单分词缺is。

questions.prompt: These flowers belong to Mum. They are ____ flowers.
questions.explanation: A Mum物主her；B his不符；C our为我们的，与明确母亲归属不合。

questions.prompt: The snail moves very ____. It takes a long time to cross the leaf.
questions.explanation: B slowly与takes long time一致；A快速相反；C大声不解释移动费时。

questions.prompt: There is ____ old bucket beside the shed.
questions.explanation: C old元音开头单数an；A不合元音冠词；B two后bucket应复数。

questions.prompt: My friend cannot find ____ gloves. They belong to him.
questions.explanation: A him男性物主his；B her不配him；C its不用于本句男孩物主。

questions.prompt: The beans are tall. ____ need long sticks to stand up.
questions.explanation: B beans复数用They；A It单数；C He人物单数不指豆株。

questions.prompt: Can you carry this small pot? Yes, ____.
questions.explanation: C回答Can用can；A be、B do不对应该情态能力问句。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the gate gently. The baby is asleep nearby.
questions.explanation: A祈使句动词原形close；B单三、C分词不独立构成指令。

questions.prompt: How ____ pots are on the tray? Three.
questions.explanation: B many问可数复数pots数量；A much问不可数；C old问年龄不接pots此结构。

units.title: 自然社出发前的五个应答

materials.title: Nature Club Matching 025
materials.text:
Match each question with the best reply. Use each reply once.
A. A small notebook and a pencil.
B. Because the path is muddy after rain.
C. The helper by the wooden gate.
D. Only after you have washed your hands.
E. In the tray labelled with your class.

questions.prompt: What do we need for drawing leaves?
options: A small notebook and a pencil.
Because the path is muddy after rain.
The helper by the wooden gate.
Only after you have washed your hands.
In the tray labelled with your class.
questions.explanation: A本和铅笔是画叶工具；B原因、C人员、D进食条件、E存放处均非用品。

questions.prompt: Why should we wear boots today?
options: A small notebook and a pencil.
Because the path is muddy after rain.
The helper by the wooden gate.
Only after you have washed your hands.
In the tray labelled with your class.
questions.explanation: B雨后路泥解释靴用途；A文具、C帮手、D洗手条件、E盘位不答原因。

questions.prompt: Who can check our group cards?
options: A small notebook and a pencil.
Because the path is muddy after rain.
The helper by the wooden gate.
Only after you have washed your hands.
In the tray labelled with your class.
questions.explanation: C木门旁帮手答Who；A用品、B原因、D时机、E盘位均非人员。

questions.prompt: May we eat our snacks after working in the soil?
options: A small notebook and a pencil.
Because the path is muddy after rain.
The helper by the wooden gate.
Only after you have washed your hands.
In the tray labelled with your class.
questions.explanation: D洗手后方可回应带条件许可；A画具、B路泥、C人员、E盘位不答食前要求。

questions.prompt: Where should we leave our finished leaf drawings?
options: A small notebook and a pencil.
Because the path is muddy after rain.
The helper by the wooden gate.
Only after you have washed your hands.
In the tray labelled with your class.
questions.explanation: E班名盘为作品放处；A用品、B原因、C人员、D洗手进食条件不答作品位置。

units.title: 舞台布置前的箱子词库

materials.title: Stage Box Bank 025
materials.text:
Choose the word for every gap. Use each word once. Bank: A. carefully B. before C. heavy D. beside E. help
We set up the stage ____1____ the audience arrives. A large box is too ____2____ for one child to lift. We ask an adult for ____3____. The adult puts it ____4____ the wall, not in the doorway. We open it ____5____ so the paper decorations inside do not tear.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: B before观众来前布台；A carefully副词不连接完整句；C heavy形容词、D beside位置、E help名动词均不接此时间从句。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C heavy与一人抬不动相应；A carefully副词、B before、D beside介词、E help名动词均非形容箱重。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E ask for help求助；A carefully副词、B before、D beside介词、C heavy形容词不能独作所求帮助名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: D beside wall与not doorway对应；A carefully方式、B before时间、C heavy状态、E help动作均不表达墙旁位置。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A carefully小心开以免纸饰破；B before、C heavy、D beside、E help均非修饰open的所需方式副词。

materials.title: Dropped Coin Story 025
materials.text: A coin rolls under a park bench. It belongs to a little child buying a postcard. Sara sees it but cannot reach it with her fingers. She does not move the heavy bench. She asks the park helper for a long broom. The helper uses it gently to move the coin out. Sara hands the coin to the child, who buys the postcard for his grandpa. He draws a small thank-you star on the back before writing the address.

questions.prompt: Who owns the coin?
questions.explanation: A小孩买明信片的钱；B教师、C帮手非物主。

questions.prompt: Why does Sara need help?
options: She cannot reach it under the bench.
She wants to buy the bench.
questions.explanation: B手指够不到；A太热、C买椅无据。

questions.prompt: What tool does the helper use?
questions.explanation: C长扫帚轻移硬币；A锯、B漆罐未用。

questions.prompt: What does Sara do with the coin?
questions.explanation: A还孩子；B留奖励、C扔池均非行为。

questions.prompt: Who is the postcard for?
questions.explanation: B送孩子爷爷；A Sara、C清洁工狗都非收件人。

materials.title: Classroom Sleeping Seed 025
materials.text: We plant seeds in a classroom tray. Each row has a label. After one week, green shoots appear in two rows, but the third row looks empty. A pupil wants to throw its soil away. The teacher asks us to read the seed packet. Those seeds usually take longer to start growing. We keep the row and continue the same careful watering. Four days later, one shoot appears. We write its date on the label instead of changing the earlier observation.

questions.prompt: Shoots appear in all three rows after one week.
questions.explanation: B正确：两行有芽，第三未见；A把两行扩大三行。

questions.prompt: The seed packet says the third kind takes longer.
questions.explanation: A正确：those seeds usually longer；B否认保留原因。

questions.prompt: The class throws the third row’s soil away immediately.
questions.explanation: B正确：keep row继续照料；A把未采纳提议当执行。

questions.prompt: One shoot appears in the third row four days later.
questions.explanation: A正确：four days later one shoot；B否认后来观察。

questions.prompt: The class records the new date without rewriting what was seen earlier.
questions.explanation: A正确：write date instead changing earlier observation；B否认时间记录边界。

materials.title: Umbrella Repair Schedule 025
materials.text:
Saturday umbrella repair desk
9:00–10:00: simple fabric patches, bring a dry umbrella.
10:00–11:00: handle checks, adult repair volunteer only.
11:30–12:30: collection of finished items.
Each visitor may bring one umbrella. Volunteers cannot promise every item can be fixed. Broken metal ribs need specialist equipment and will be returned with advice. Attach your booking number to the handle; do not put your home address on the public label. If your repair is not ready by collection time, staff will contact you using the private booking record. Please do not queue before 8:50 because the building entrance must remain clear.

questions.prompt: Which session is for fabric patches?
questions.explanation: C九至十补布；A把手检查；B领取；D无下午场。

questions.prompt: What should a visitor bring for patching?
questions.explanation: A干伞且每人一把；B多把且湿；C公共标不可家址；D访客无需金属设备。

questions.prompt: What happens to broken metal ribs?
options: They are returned with specialist advice.
They are guaranteed fixed by nine.
They are hidden in finished umbrellas.
questions.explanation: B需专门设备故返并建议；A儿童单修、C保证、D隐藏均无据。

questions.prompt: What should be written on the public item label?
options: Only the date of every storm.
questions.explanation: D预约号标签贴柄；A家址明禁；B邻号、C风暴记录非内容。

questions.prompt: How will someone hear about an unfinished repair?
options: Through the private booking contact record.
By reading every public home address.
By waiting at the entrance all night.
questions.explanation: A员工用私预约记录联系；B公示家址不允许；C/D不是通知方式。

units.title: 长椅上那张请勿搬走的便条

materials.title: Garden Bench Note Story 025
materials.text: A new bench appeared beside our block’s garden. Someone attached a note saying, "Please leave this space clear on Tuesdays." I thought the bench was reserved for one person every week. Later, I saw a delivery worker push a trolley through the gap next to it. The note was about the path, not the seat. The garden team moved the note to a small post beside the gap and added the words "Delivery access." People could still sit on the bench while keeping their bags out of the route. I was glad the new sign explained the purpose instead of making us guess.

questions.prompt: The writer first thinks the bench itself is reserved every Tuesday.
questions.explanation: A正确：初以为每周一人专座；B否认初始理解。

questions.prompt: The gap is used for delivery access.
questions.explanation: A正确：工人推车，后牌Delivery access；B否认目的。

questions.prompt: The final rule forbids everyone from sitting on the bench.
questions.explanation: B正确：仍可坐，只包不挡路；A把通道限制扩大禁座。

questions.prompt: The sign is moved closer to the relevant gap.
questions.explanation: A正确：移到gap旁小柱；B否认位置改进。

questions.prompt: The revised sign gives no reason for keeping the space clear.
questions.explanation: B正确：补Delivery access明确理由；A否认解释。

units.title: 读书社交流后的词形笔记

materials.title: Book Club Note Forms 025
materials.text:
Use the correct one-word form of each word to complete all five sentences.
1. Yesterday, Liv ____1____ (write) the discussion questions on a card.
2. The two ____2____ (woman) from the village library joined our meeting.
3. This story is ____3____ (short) than the one we read last week.
4. Please listen ____4____ (patient; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) while another member explains an idea.
5. The blue notebooks are ____5____ (they); the pupils put their names inside.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use WRITE.
questions.explanation: 接受wrote：Yesterday过去时，write不规则变wrote；write原形、writed错误、writing分词不作独立过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use WOMAN.
questions.explanation: 接受women：two明确复数，woman不规则变women；woman单数、womans错误、womens重复加s均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use SHORT.
questions.explanation: 接受shorter：than比较两故事长度；short原级、shortest最高级、shortly副词均非该比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from PATIENT.
questions.explanation: 接受patiently：本空明确要求PATIENT派生的常规-ly副词。列出的其他形态不满足本题-ly任务约束；这并不声称其在所有英语语境中不合法，也不因缺少明示比较就否定可能的隐含比较。未列形式仍进入复核。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: use THEY.
questions.explanation: 接受theirs：are后独立物主表语，后无名词；they主格、their需接名词、them宾格不合所有关系。

units.title: 展览参观中的具体交际

materials.title: Exhibition Help Functions 025
materials.text: Choose the best sentence for each visitor’s stated purpose.

questions.prompt: You are asked to keep a doorway clear and want to check where your bag can go. What should you ask?
options: Where may I leave my bag without blocking the doorway?
Why is every doorway a square?
Can I close the whole exhibition?
questions.explanation: A问不堵门的存包点；B几何泛问、C关展不达存包需求。

questions.prompt: A label is too small for you to read. You want another format. What should you say?
options: Is a larger-print version of this label available?
questions.explanation: B具体请求大字形式；A否定价值、C全撤说明不帮助阅读。

questions.prompt: You have accidentally stepped ahead of a waiting visitor. You want to correct it politely. What should you say?
options: I am sorry; you were waiting before me. Please go ahead.
questions.explanation: C承认先后并礼让；A抢先、B否排队不纠失礼。

questions.prompt: You want to know whether a displayed model may be touched. What should you ask?
options: May visitors touch this model, or should we only look?
How many stars are in the sky?
Could you sell me the building?
questions.explanation: A明确触摸许可边界；B星数、C买楼均无关。

questions.prompt: A guide has answered your question, and you want to confirm your understanding. What should you say?
options: I will pretend I heard everything.
So the workshop starts at two, and we meet here. Is that right?
Your shoes are not my size.
questions.explanation: B复述两个具体点并求确认；A假装理解、C鞋尺无关澄清。
